adoptedUnit.sourceClassification: NEW_TEST_ONLY_BRANCH_SCOPED_SOURCE; not canonical or generally operative
adoptedUnit.adoptionRule: The four bound proposal fields are one indivisible adoption unit. Taxonomy-only adoption is expressly insufficient.
adoptedUnit.effect: Upon lawful completion and successful resolution of the bound Lich ritual, add Undead once to the same active character while retaining Humanoid. The character identity, extant body, life state, position, orientation, occupied volume, HP, conditions, resources, equipment, cargo and custody remain unchanged. The taxonomy is permanent under the proposal, with no concentration, expiry or automatic reversion; no separate taxonomy cost or unlisted immunity, ancestry package, recovery, or card is granted.
adoptedUnit.eligibilityAndReadiness: The proposal's exact Mage class-level and lawful Lich Hero-path access gates apply; initial type set is exactly Humanoid and Undead is absent. Before the scheduled interval, readiness requires either one qualifying Soul Coin or two participants, at least two named mini-boss guardians, a secured planar nexus, and survival of the divine-echo encounter. Existing third-guardian +2 and willing-participant advantage modifiers remain as bound in the proposal. All requirements are rechecked immediately before the final roll.
adoptedUnit.ritualProcedure: The proposed final ritual step is one continuous 3600-second interval at the secured nexus on the ordinary elapsed-world-time clock. It is scheduled activity, not a spell cast or regular Action; it creates no turn, Action, Reaction, refresh, or paused clock, and the Mage takes no other voluntary activity. Historical failure stakes are disclosed and the player opts in before the interval; consent may be withdrawn before the final roll, aborting without a check or failure consequence. Listed interruption conditions abort before the roll, with no partial-duration resumption; a new attempt requires the full duration and fresh prerequisite checks and consent. Damage alone does not interrupt unless a listed condition occurs. Ordinary world events and clocks continue.
adoptedUnit.paymentAndResolution: For the Soul Coin route, confirm one qualifying coin is acquired and available before the interval and immediately before the roll; if a roll is attempted, commit and consume one coin immediately before it, whether the result succeeds or fails. No coin is consumed if interrupted before the roll. Alternatively, two participants remain available and are not consumed or killed; if both are willing at the final check, apply the proposal's advantage. The participant route replaces the Soul Coin route and adds no RP, spell-slot, or material payment. The existing final check and failure outcome remain as bound in the proposal. Add Undead only immediately after successful resolution; preparation, declaration, decline, interruption, or failure never changes taxonomy.
